ticket.subject: Feature idea: Gantt charts
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

I look after our account at Kettlewick Ltd. Please consider adding a Gantt chart view; we plan long projects with many steps.

Right now we export to a spreadsheet to see the timeline.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Is this on your roadmap?

Best regards,
Mateo
